entry.title: Paradiso Quintessence Robusto — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Coffee, espresso, dark chocolate or dark rum
entry.summaryHtml: Coffee, toasted almond, cedar, dried plum, cocoa and brown sugar give the Quintessence Robusto a rounded medium-full profile. The Ecuador Habano wrapper brings sweetness and aromatic spice over an all-Nicaraguan core, with enough pepper and toast to keep the fruit and honeyed notes from becoming soft.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the exact 5.5″ × 50 Paradiso Quintessence Robusto single at A$40.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua by My Father
